##### Project general facts

Ananda Residences is a fifty-four-story twin-tower development by Tiger Properties. Inspired by the Sanskrit word for bliss, happiness, and pure joy, this architectural marvel is set to redefine urban sophistication, offering residents an unparalleled blend of comfort, convenience, and contemporary design. Ananda is more than a residence — it is a lifestyle of serenity and fulfillment, where luxury meets tranquility in the heart of the city.

Water takes center stage at Ananda Residences as a symbol of tranquility and refinement. The expansive, state-of-the-art swimming pool offers a serene retreat surrounded by lush greenery and contemporary lounge spaces, providing a refreshing escape amidst the vibrant energy of urban living. Whether enjoying a tranquil swim, unwinding by the water, or simply taking in the calming ambiance, the pool embodies the perfect balance of elegance and peace.

Every material at Ananda Residences is meticulously selected to ensure durability, elegance, and sustainability. From high-quality marble and premium wood finishes to cutting-edge glass and sleek metal accents, each element reflects superior craftsmanship. The fusion of modern textures and timeless materials enhances both aesthetics and functionality, creating homes that are fully furnished with fully equipped kitchens, as stunning as they are enduring.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Motor City, this exceptional location combines the essence of urban living with a captivating theme centered around motorsports and automobiles. The community is an embodiment of modernity, innovation, and passion, with streets adorned with a distinct charm and architectural design that pays homage to famous race tracks and automotive legends.

The location is distinguished by its commitment to green spaces and beautifully manicured parks and lush gardens, providing a peaceful retreat for residents to unwind, exercise, or simply enjoy the outdoors. It is a place where enthusiasts and families alike come together, united by their shared love for everything automotive, while still enjoying a serene and welcoming environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies blissful living, architectural excellence, and a prime Dubai address, Motor City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of automotive passion, green spaces, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
